comparison.objective: Hang a tool bag on a rail while avoiding a sprinkler pipe; unrelated to damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Load lifting, hook/handle placement, and target discrimination versus precision tool insertion and mechanical adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Title requires rail support and forbids sprinkler-pipe support; body, retention duration, load, damage rules, and all specs are missing.
comparison.reason: It tests safe support selection and hanging, not response-based damping calibration.
